actual_request.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, reusable environment master for a gothic fantasy animated rescue short. Input image is the MASTER art-style and mood reference: delicate anime illustration, deep brown-black shadows, copper candle highlights, fine fabric/stone texture, readable focal light. Create one wide 16:9 EMPTY church nave at night, viewed from near the main entrance toward the far altar with a slight angle so the left wall is visible. Consistent simple layout: a single central aisle with dark wooden pews on both sides; three broad worn stone steps to a raised altar at the far end; ONE tall unoccupied heavy wooden cross fixed securely at the center, iron mounting cuffs and chains visible; an unlit modest stack of dry logs at its base; a shallow stone basin with water to the side of the steps; tall pointed windows and ribbed vaults, clustered candles. A small rough dog-sized crawl opening at floor level of the left side wall, near the rear of the pews, is discreetly visible and connects outside. The large main double doors are BEHIND THE CAMERA, not beside the altar. Frame the whole useful staging space, making the aisle/steps/altar and side-wall passage readable while retaining dark mood. Limited pale moonlight from high windows, warm candles, no active blaze, no smoke hiding structure. The setting is fictional; no real-world church name, signs, text, human victims, characters, bodies, blood or gore. No complex extra chambers, monster statue, futuristic machines, floorplan, labels, watermark or prompt box. One full-bleed image with detailed gothic-fantasy anime environment painting matching the reference.
